records.title: אגרות קודש חי״ב עמ׳ קל — התלבטות בשידוך והפסקת מפגשים זמנית
records.summary_researcher: Published English compilation states that the response addresses a letter dated 26 Cheshvan in which a woman says she has known a young man for years but finds it difficult to decide whether to marry him. The response recommends a temporary period without meetings to clarify her inner feelings. The incoming letter is not reproduced.
